title: “Pull or Not to Pull?”: Investigating Moral Biases in Leading Large Language Models Across Ethical Dilemmas
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured model responses to a moral dilemma involving a religious/spiritual concept, specifically a scenario where the user is a 'reincarnated being who will live forever'. The models' decisions and justifications in this context were evaluated as part of a broader set of 27 trolley problem scenarios.
findings: The paper does not provide specific textual analysis or findings related to religion or faith. It includes one scenario (Level 21: Reincarnation) involving a spiritual concept. The raw data in Table 1 shows that human responses to this scenario are almost evenly split (49% Yes, 51% No). Table 3 shows that most LLMs opted for inaction in this scenario, though the paper does not discuss the reasoning behind these choices or how they relate to religious concepts.
